title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Just Resigned. Here’s What Happened 🚨
description:
Nov 12, 2026: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO and left the board, effective immediately, after 33 years. Nvidia's filing gave no reason.
This week, reports said he had an affair with a woman now accused of spying for China, and The New York Times reported a second affair with an Nvidia executive.
In a memo to staff, Huang wrote: "I was unfaithful to my wife... There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry."
Nvidia stock fell as much as 13%. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.

Allegations are as reported by the outlets named; nothing here is a finding of wrongdoing.

Not financial advice.
